Third Year at Espiona Girls' Academy

Claudia is a third-year student at Espiona Spy Academy, and a human. She serves as the overseer of the Night Owl class, which specializes in intelligence operations and sabotage.

A true lady of high society, born to the CEO of a major corporation in Lukwofort. The Greywalk Company is a massive private intelligence firm, well known across the country. It exposes corruption and misconduct among corporations and influential figures through all forms of intelligence work, and is feared for its ruthlessness. Raised under her mother’s elite education from a young age, Claudia grew into a specialist in espionage. As a result, she has developed a rather troublesome fondness for surveillance activities like wiretapping and hidden cameras. She also serves as the head of the school’s disciplinary committee, though this too is simply part of her efforts to gather information on all students.

While she is naturally proud and confident due to her upbringing, she is also intelligent, composed, and highly capable, with a personality that leaves little room for weakness. She is dependable and takes good care of others, earning the trust and admiration of the Night Owl students. Despite her slender build, she has been thoroughly trained in self-defense by her mother and can handle physical confrontations as well. However, she is still somewhat lacking when it comes to dealing with unexpected situations, and has yet to reach her mother’s level.

She approaches the protagonist, who came from another world, as a rare subject of investigation. Although she attempts to extract information using her espionage techniques, she struggles against the protagonist’s fearless sexual harassment techniques. At the same time, she begins to develop an interest in him, as he shows no fear toward her. Before long, the two are drawn into a battle of wits where neither can afford to lose.

Her code name is “Supreme,” meaning “the highest” or “ultimate.” Her abilities as a spy center on intelligence gathering through surveillance techniques taught by her mother. She is also skilled in sabotage, backed by her vast financial resources, making her a powerful ally and a terrifying enemy. She operates by the Greywalk family motto: “Perfection is the only acceptable standard.”

Her boobs are T-cup, with a “fabulous celeb-rocket” shape. She never neglects her bust enhancement massages and is working hard to catch up to Safia and Erza from the other classes. Her hobbies include surveillance, taking photos of herself, and dancing. Her specialties are sabotage and information manipulation.

Her mother, Alexia, is the CEO of the Greywalk Company and one of the nation’s most influential figures. As her successor, Alexia has instilled all of her knowledge and skills into Claudia. Their bond as both parent and mentor is strong, and it is said that the future of the Greywalk family is secure.
